summary: Budget Warning feature for Payment Requests tested successfully. Backend API and Frontend UI both working correctly. All 7 features verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Budget Warning feature for Payment Requests is complete. Testing verified: 1) Budget-check API returns correct warnings (no_budget, over_budget, low_budget, OK), 2) Frontend displays warnings with correct styling, 3) Payment approval still works with budget warnings.

budget_check_api_endpoint.description: GET /api/project-requests/{request_id}/budget-check returns correct budget info for payment requests
budget_check_api_endpoint.evidence: API returns: request_id, request_no, payment_amount, budget, total_expenses, available_budget, budget_after_payment, warning, warning_message

no_budget_warning_styling.description: No budget warning appears with amber/yellow styling when project has no budget
no_budget_warning_styling.evidence: Screenshot shows amber warning banner with text: '⚠️ No budget allocated for this project. Payment can still be approved but will not be tracked against budget.'

over_budget_warning_code_verified.description: Over budget warning appears with red styling when payment exceeds available budget
over_budget_warning_code_verified.evidence: Code in PurchaseManagement.js lines 760-761 shows: 'over_budget' ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200'. No PIDs with budget>0 in test data to trigger this case.

budget_ok_message_code_verified.description: Budget OK message appears with green styling when budget is sufficient
budget_ok_message_code_verified.evidence: Code in PurchaseManagement.js lines 777-783 shows green styling: 'bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200' with 'Budget OK - {available} available after this payment'

budget_warning_in_update_modal.description: Budget warning displays in Update Request modal when opening a payment request
budget_warning_in_update_modal.evidence: Screenshot shows Update Request modal with budget warning section at top, checkBudgetForPayment function called when modal opens (lines 268-273)

payment_approval_with_warning.description: Payment approval still works even with budget warning (not a blocker)
payment_approval_with_warning.evidence: Screenshot shows 'Approved' status can be selected, and green hint '✓ Expense entry will be auto-created when approved' appears

expense_auto_creation_on_approval.description: Expense auto-creation on payment approval continues to work
expense_auto_creation_on_approval.evidence: Code verified in project_requests.py lines 1405-1459 - AUTO-CREATE EXPENSE logic intact when payment status = 'approved'
